english.objective: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
english.complete:
Ah... <name>... child of the four winds... You seek understanding. You seek answers. Why have the winds left you? How may you get them back? These are answers I cannot provide, for I do not know the motives or movements of the winds.

I can, however, teach you much of the earth. Its strength, its resolve. Even here, high in this endless sea of clouds, you are still a creature of the earth. If you hope to find the strength to speak to the spirits of the four winds once more, this is the path you must walk.
english.detail:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: As you will come to learn, the path we walk is not as simple as it may seem. While we seek to find the voice needed to speak with the spirits of the winds, the winds are but one of the elemental forces of this world. Only through understanding, and--we hope--mastery of all four elements will we regain our voice to again sing the songs of the wind.
english.complete:
Good!

The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among <class>--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.

The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.

But for now, take this earth totem...
english.detail:
Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

english.objective: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.

How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our skyborne gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.
english.detail:
Well hello there, <name>! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!

english.objective: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
english.progress: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
english.complete:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.
english.detail:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.

english.objective: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
english.progress: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
english.complete:
The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.

<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>

...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.
english.detail:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.
english.detail:

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
english.objective: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.
english.progress: Any catches to speak of?
english.complete: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

english.detail: This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

english.title: An Enticing Offer
english.detail: I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process. There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away. And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
english.objective: Collect 6 Vials of Animal Blood and 18 Duskweed Petals for murloc bait, then return to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.
english.progress: Find everything?
english.complete:
Give me just a minute...
It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.

english.title: Discipline
english.detail: You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me. As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess. Swiftly now--<name>, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
english.objective: Punish 5 Deathguards for Executor Zygand.
english.progress: This had better be good.
english.complete:
There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.
You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.

english.title: Patience
english.detail: Make no mistake, <class>--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens. Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name. You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
english.objective: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
english.progress: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
english.complete:
I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.
You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
